Noise fails by 4.6× (822 nV/√Hz vs. 180 nV/√Hz at 1 kHz). That level points to flicker noise in the small NMOS input pair, which nothing else in the design addresses. Sensitivity to gmid1 and L1 is strong, so the fix is a much larger input-pair area: higher gm/Id and L = 2 µm.

A PMOS input pair is not an option. With Vcm = 0.9 V and |Vgs| ≈ 1.1 V, it does not fit under VDD = 1.62 V.

The second problem is M5, which has only 28 mV of Vds−Vdsat margin. I'll run the NMOS current sources at gm/Id 18 to cut Vdsat. I'll also correct the slew, CMRR and noise models.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Noise is dominated by flicker in the small NMOS input pair; enlarge its area (gm/Id 20, L 2um). Raise NMOS source gm/Id to fix M5 headroom. Correct the slew, CMRR and noise models."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20, 16, 24),        # diff pair gm/Id (large area for low 1/f noise)
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),     # diff pair L
    "Itail": (12e-6, 8e-6, 24e-6),
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),     # PMOS load + 2nd stage PMOS L
    "gmidp": (10, 7, 14),         # PMOS load / 2nd stage gm/Id
    "I6":    (50e-6, 25e-6, 80e-6),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),     # NMOS current sources L
    "gmidn": (17, 13, 20),        # NMOS current sources gm/Id (low Vdsat)
    "Cc":    (3.0e-12, 1.5e-12, 5e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.6, 1.6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    gn = p["gmidn"]
    mb = lut.size("n", gn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gn, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=m6vgs if False else 1.0)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)

    gm6 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 + CL / Cc) / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * Cc + C1 * CL + CL * Cc) / (2 * PI)
    p3 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg + 1e-30)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) * (abs(1 - p["kz"]) + 0.3) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) * 0.5
    slew = 0.63 * min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.15
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (max(m5.gds, 1e-15) * (m1.gds + m3.gds) + 1e-30) * 0.01)
    psrr = gain - 12
    therm2 = 2 * 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    # empirical flicker: ~2.6 uV/rtHz*um at 1 kHz for the pair, scales 1/sqrt(W*L)
    flick = 2.6e-6 / math.sqrt(max(m1.W * m1.L, 1e-3))
    flick_p = 1.0e-6 / math.sqrt(max(m3.W * m3.L, 1e-3)) * (m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(therm2 + flick ** 2 + flick_p ** 2)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power,
               "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr,
               "noise_1k": noise}
```
